title: Occupant load calculated with the correct load factor
test: Pass if the sheet states an occupant load and the factor used matches the use (residential 200 gross sq ft per occupant, mercantile 60 gross sq ft per occupant). Fail if the factor is wrong for the use. Needs review if no occupant load is shown.

title: Egress capacity of doors and corridors
test: Pass if the egress width of doors, corridors and other components (other than stairs) is at least 0.2 in. per occupant served, using the stated occupant load. Fail if the documented width is less.

title: Minimum number of exits per story
test: Pass if each story with an occupant load of 1 to 500 has at least two exits or access to two exits. Fail if only one exit is shown and no single-exit exception is claimed.

title: Separation of two exits (one-third diagonal when sprinklered)
test: Pass if the two exits are separated by at least one-half of the overall diagonal of the area served, or at least one-third of that diagonal when the building is fully sprinklered. Fail if the stated separation is less than the required fraction of the stated diagonal.

title: Common path of egress travel
test: Pass if the common path of egress travel in Group R-2 does not exceed 125 ft in a sprinklered building (75 ft unsprinklered). Fail if a longer common path is shown.

title: Exit access travel distance
test: Pass if the maximum exit access travel distance in Group R-2 is 250 ft or less in a sprinklered building (200 ft unsprinklered). Fail if the stated maximum travel distance is longer.

title: Minimum corridor width
test: Pass if corridors serving an occupant load of 50 or more are at least 44 in. clear (36 in. allowed only where the occupant load served is less than 50). Fail if a corridor serving 50 or more occupants is shown narrower than 44 in.

title: Dead-end corridor length
test: Pass if dead-end corridors do not exceed 20 ft, or 50 ft in Group B, E, F, I-1, M, R-1, R-2, S and U occupancies in a fully sprinklered building. Fail if a longer dead end is shown.

title: Egress door clear width
test: Pass if means of egress doors provide at least 32 in. clear width. Fail if a smaller clear width is shown for an egress door.

title: Exit signs and emergency illumination
test: Pass if exit signs are shown at exits and where the exit path is not apparent, and emergency illumination of at least 1 foot-candle average along the egress path is specified. Fail if either is missing or the illumination level is lower.
